# [TASK] Kibana homepage linking the Lens dashboard suite

## Task
Add a Kibana homepage/landing dashboard that links the 3 Lens dashboards from #71 (Service Health, Error Triage, Per-Service Deep-Dive), so there's one obvious starting point instead of navigating Kibana's dashboard list.

## Scope
A markdown/links panel dashboard is enough — no new data visualizations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A Kibana dashboard surfaces links to all 3 dashboards from #71, and Kibana's `defaultRoute` setting points at it (`grep -o 'lmdb-service-health\|lmdb-error-triage\|lmdb-per-service-deep-dive' infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/lmdb-homepage.ndjson | sort -u | wc -l` → 3; `grep -c 'defaultRoute.*lmdb-homepage' infrastructure/docker/elk/setup/setup.sh` → 1)
- [x] Checked into `infrastructure/docker/elk/kibana/*.ndjson`, imported by `setup.sh` (`grep -c "lmdb-homepage.ndjson" infrastructure/docker/elk/setup/setup.sh` → 1)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
`lmdb-homepage.ndjson` holds a single markdown panel linking Service Health / Error Triage / Per-Service Deep-Dive by their dashboard IDs; `defaultRoute` is set via the settings API rather than through the ndjson (see `infrastructure/docker/elk/setup/setup.sh`), so opening Kibana lands there directly.

The `filmpire-*` names in this issue's original text are stale — #151 renamed the project to LMDB, and the file, dashboard ID, and route here are all `lmdb-*` today.
